newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Lippo Securities to buy Lippo Life stake.
newsitem.headline: Lippo Securities to buy Lippo Life stake.

text.p: Indonesia's PT Lippo Securities said on Wednesday it planned to buy 26.99 percent of the shares of PT Asuransi Lippo Life worth 243.67 billion rupiah.
Lippo Securities said in a statement that the planned purchase, subject to shareholders's approval, was aimed at boosting the firm's efforts in widening its marketing network.
It said the insurance firm Lippo Life already had an extensive marketing network.
Lippo Securities also said the planned share purchase was aimed at improving the firm's efforts in mobilising long term funds.
Lippo Securities said it expected to finance the purchase using 100 billion rupiah in cash and 143.67 billion rupiah in loans.
It said the shareholders' meeting was scheduled for September 27, 1996.
The share purchase will increase Lippo Securities' stake in the insurance firm to 31.89 percent from the existing 4.90 percent.
Both Lippo Securities and Lippo Life are members of the widely diversified the Lippo Group.
